name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 2px focus ring with 4.5:1 contrast and a 1px outer shadow at 3:1 contrast. This keeps the ring visible on all backgrounds while avoiding harsh edges that strain eyes. The trade-off is slightly thicker focus rings on high-contrast modes, but it ensures keyboard users never lose track of focus.

name: Reader
text: The 2px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast still risks disappearing on patterned backgrounds with mid-tone colors. A 3px ring at 7:1 contrast on interactive elements solves this but may feel heavy. Test with a 10-person keyboard user group on live EXCAVA pages—if any fail to track focus, adopt the thicker ring.
